Why vendored as-is:
  ULTRONE integrates with WorldWideView at arm's length (reference
  implementation, plugin-SDK patterns, Agent Bus control surface) rather
  than copying its code into ULTRONE-owned packages. To refresh, replace
  this directory with a newer upstream checkout (excluding .git) and
  update the commit hash above.
